description: DEPRECATED alias of gripforge_generate_prop with provider=compute (same request through the single generation door POST /api/v1/generate-asset, same answer); prefer that tool. ON DEMAND ONLY: use when the user asks for GripForge Compute; the default 3D generator stays gripforge_generate_prop without provider. Make textured 3D prop/furniture assets with GripForge Compute from images or text descriptions: one asset (name + prompt or image) or several at once (items, up to 5; each item is one asset, from its prompt or its image). Two steps: stage=quote (free) returns each quote.token and the total price; show it to the user, then stage=generate with the tokens (quote_token, or quote_tokens in item order) and confirm=true launches one durable job per asset, each debited once after success with its own idempotency key. Text assets stop after four reference images (billed on their own): show them to the user, then gripforge_compute_validate with the chosen image (the 3D is quoted then, and billed when finished), or regenerate; auto_pick=true (only if the user asked) takes the first image and bills images + 3D once. Weapons are refused before any charge; characters, mobs, creatures and vehicles need their type. Returns one job per asset with studio_url; poll gripforge_generation_read (or this alias family: gripforge_compute_job) for the GLBs and their edit_url.

auto_pick.description: Text assets: true = take the first image without asking (only when the user explicitly wants it). Default: stop and wait for gripforge_compute_validate

confirm.description: stage=generate: true once the user accepted the quoted price

idempotency_key.description: Single asset: stable key for retries of the same launch; generated if absent (items: one per item, derived from it)

image_base64.description: source=image: PNG/JPEG/WebP, raw base64 or data URI, up to 8 MB

image_path.description: source=image: local PNG/JPEG/WebP file (instead of image_base64)

items.description: Several assets at once: [{name, prompt} or {name, image_base64|image_path}]

object_type.description: Size (budget) of the type, e.g. petit_objet, mobilier_simple; default: the type's default

options.description: Image assets: photo (keep visible details), matieres (refine materials), relief (surface detail). Default all three

prompt.description: source=text: one object, e.g. "a studded wooden pirate chest"

quote_token.description: stage=generate, single asset: quote.token from the quote with the SAME inputs

quote_tokens.description: stage=generate with items: the quote tokens in item order

source.description: Single asset: default image. Items: inferred from each item (prompt → text, image → image)

triangles.description: Image assets only: exact triangle count of the « near » GLB (the « scene » one gets half). Default: from object_type. For a finished asset (also from text), use gripforge_compute_variant kind=budget

type.description: Asset type (gripforge_compute_status lists those the router makes now). personnage / mob / creature: the mesh only; rig and animate it afterwards in the Character studio. Weapons are refused

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to it.

name: gripforge_compute_generate
title: Compute · generate 3D assets (deprecated alias)
